title: The pre-commit formatter gate checks markdown only: Rust is declared and rustfmt-enforced everywhere except at commit time, on a stale bash-only premise
body:
The formatter gate in `.git/hooks/pre-commit` refuses unformatted MARKDOWN and checks nothing else. Rust is declared, rustfmt is adopted, CI enforces it, and the commit path does not.

MEASURED. The hook is 78 lines. It carries one formatter stanza, markdown through prettier, and its closing comment reads:

    # The mix format block that used to sit here is gone: Utilz is bash-only, has no
    # mix.exs, and dropped `elixir` from config.json languages on 2026-07-29.

"Utilz is bash-only" is no longer true. `intent/.config/config.json` declares `shell` AND `rust`; rustfmt was adopted for the prez crate on hv's ruling (issue 0036) with `opt/prez/crate/rustfmt.toml` at `tab_spaces = 2`; `bin/.devbin/config.yaml` declares both arms, `check format` and `fmt rust`; and `.github/workflows/tests.yml` runs `cargo fmt --all --check` ahead of clippy. Every layer enforces it except the one that runs at commit time.

THE CONSEQUENCE, MEASURED RATHER THAN SUPPOSED. Issue 0059: four consecutive commits carried six formatting diffs and the first thing to report it was CI, one push later. The workflow's own comment warns about exactly this shape -- a gate that fails "on the NEXT push rather than on the commit that gated the legs" -- and this is that, one layer further out.

WHY THIS IS NOT SIMPLY A COMMIT. The hook is NOT TRACKED IN GIT and says so in its own last line. There is no source for it in the tree: nothing under a `hooks/` path is tracked, and the stanza text appears nowhere outside `.git/`. So a rust stanza added here lives on one machine, ships to nobody, and silently does not exist for any other checkout or for CI. That is the part that needs a ruling rather than an edit: either the hook gains a tracked source in this repo, or the pre-commit formatter gate becomes something the Intent install serves the way it already serves the Claude Code lifecycle hook bodies.

THE NARROW FIX, if the hook stays untracked and per-machine: one stanza mirroring the markdown one, checking staged `*.rs` through `cargo fmt --check` and refusing with `bin/devbin fmt rust` as the named remedy. It must judge the STAGED bytes, as the markdown stanza does and for the reason recorded there (Intent issue 0498), never rewrite the worktree.

RECOMMENDED AFTER THE CUT. It is a process gap rather than a release blocker; 0059 is what blocks the cut and it is fixed on its own.
